name: io.github.JohnnyFoulds/markdown-for-agents-mcp
description: MCP server for AI agents — fetch any URL with full JavaScript rendering (3-tier render ladder: plain HTTP, Lightpanda, Playwright/Chromium) and convert to clean, token-efficient markdown. Includes web search, batch fetching, site crawl, binary file download, CSS selector extraction, output formats, LRU cache, SSRF protection, and structured output.

environmentVariables.name: FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout per fetch request in milliseconds (default: 30000)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_CONCURRENT_FETCHES
environmentVariables.description: Max parallel fetches in batch operations (default: 5)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH
environmentVariables.description: Max content size in characters before truncation (default: 100000)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, or ERROR (default: INFO)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Log format: text or json (default: text)

environmentVariables.name: CACHE_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum in-memory cache size in bytes (default: 52428800 = 50 MB)

environmentVariables.name: CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Cache time-to-live in milliseconds (default: 900000 = 15 min)

environmentVariables.name: USE_ALLOWLIST_MODE
environmentVariables.description: When true, only domains listed in BLOCKLIST_DOMAINS are allowed (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: BLOCKLIST_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domains to block (or allow in allowlist mode)

environmentVariables.name: BLOCKLIST_URL_PATTERNS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated URL patterns to block

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: When set, starts an HTTP server on this port instead of stdio

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required on all HTTP requests (HTTP mode only). Stored in Secrets Manager in production.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: HTTP transport mode: stateless (default, N-replica safe) or session (requires Ingress affinity)

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_PROXY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Proxy server URL for all outbound HTTP requests (e.g. http://proxy:8080). Canonical var; PLAYWRIGHT_PROXY is a legacy alias.

environmentVariables.name: PROXY_PINS
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of proxy URLs for round-robin rotation, e.g. '["http://p1:3128","http://p2:3128"]'. Overrides HTTP_PROXY_URL when set.

environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Legacy alias for HTTP_PROXY_URL. Use HTTP_PROXY_URL in new deployments.

environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_PROXY_BYPASS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hostnames that bypass the proxy

environmentVariables.name: DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout for file download requests in milliseconds (default: 60000)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum file size for downloads in bytes (default: 52428800 = 50 MB)

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOST_RPS
environmentVariables.description: Max requests per second per host. 0 = unlimited (default). Shared across replicas when STORE_BACKEND=redis.

environmentVariables.name: RATE_LIMIT_BURST
environmentVariables.description: Token-bucket burst size for rate limiting (default: 10)

environmentVariables.name: STORE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Store backend: auto (memory for stdio, sqlite for HTTP), memory, sqlite, or redis (default: auto)

environmentVariables.name: STORE_REDIS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Redis connection URL when STORE_BACKEND=redis (e.g. redis://localhost:6379)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: Process role: server (default), worker (crawl worker only), or both

environmentVariables.name: LIGHTPANDA_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Enable Lightpanda as Tier 2 in the render ladder (default: false). Requires a running Lightpanda CDP server.

environmentVariables.name: LIGHTPANDA_CDP_URL
environmentVariables.description: CDP WebSocket URL for Lightpanda (default: ws://127.0.0.1:9222)

environmentVariables.name: STEALTH_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Use playwright-extra + puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth for Tier 3 browser fingerprint hardening (default: false). Requires optional packages.

environmentVariables.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Brave Search API key for web search (Tier 1 provider)

environmentVariables.name: SERPER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Serper API key for Google SERP results (Tier 1 provider)

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_URL
environmentVariables.description: SearXNG instance URL for self-hosted search (Tier 2 provider)

environmentVariables.name: SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_MS
environmentVariables.description: Time to wait for load-balancer drain before closing the HTTP server (default: 5000)

environmentVariables.name: SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum time to wait for in-flight requests during graceful shutdown (default: 30000)
